mara.instruct: A woman in her early fifties with a warm, husky alto and a light Scottish accent. Dry humour, quick and plain-spoken like a veteran radio dispatcher, a little smoky, affectionate under the gruffness.
mara.ref: Wren? It's Mara. Put the kettle on, kid, it's going to be a long shift. I've got three jobs, two of them legal, and one that actually pays.
mara.name: Heirframe · Mara Quill

hira.instruct: A young woman, mid-twenties, bright and bubbly American accent, crisp and slightly over-enunciated like a customer-service chatbot, fast and upbeat, with a sing-song lift at the end of sentences.
hira.ref: Good morning, valued rider! Your HireFrame R-1 is fully charged and ready for another brighter day. Have you considered our premium plan?
hira.name: Heirframe · HIRA

iris.instruct: A woman in her late sixties with a warm, clear British received-pronunciation accent. Sharp and intelligent, slightly frail but quick, kind with a dry wit, speaks like a professor who loves her students.
iris.ref: If you are hearing this, then you found it, and I am so very proud of you. Listen carefully, little star. There isn't much time, and there is so much I should have told you.
iris.name: Heirframe · Iris Vael

dray.instruct: A man sounding in his sixties with a deep, smooth, resonant baritone and a polished mid-Atlantic accent. Slow, measured and paternal, like a beloved statesman giving a eulogy, never raising his voice.
dray.ref: Nobody here has ever gone hungry. Nobody here has ever been afraid. That is what we built, together. Surely a little quiet is a fair price for paradise.
dray.name: Heirframe · Archon Dray

lyra.instruct: A woman in her mid-forties with a clear mezzo-soprano voice, slightly hoarse, neutral southern-English accent, determined and tender, speaks softly but with steel underneath.
lyra.ref: Listen to me. Whatever they tell you about us, it isn't true. We tried to do the right thing. Be brave, and be kind, and whatever happens, keep going.
lyra.name: Heirframe · Lyra Vael

tomas.instruct: A man in his early thirties with a gentle, warm tenor and a light Scottish accent. Laughs easily, soft-spoken and kind, a little breathless and urgent when scared.
tomas.ref: Ha! Did you see that? Tiny hand, iron grip. Oh, this one's going to be trouble, I can tell already. Come here, little star. Come here.
tomas.name: Heirframe · Tomas Quill

fenn.instruct: An elderly man around eighty with a soft, papery voice and a gentle Welsh lilt. Slow, careful and kind, with a slight tremor, like a retired librarian.
fenn.ref: Ah. You have her eyes, you know. Please, sit down. Mind the roses. I have kept this garden for twenty-two years, and nobody has ever asked me why.
fenn.name: Heirframe · Dr Abel Fenn

kettle.instruct: A man in his late forties with a big gravelly bass voice and a broad East London Cockney accent. Boisterous, theatrical and jolly-menacing, like a gangster who thinks he's a comedian.
kettle.ref: Oi oi! What have we got here, then? A little rental, all on its lonesome. That key's worth a family fortune, that is. Hand it over, there's a good sport.
kettle.name: Heirframe · Big Kettle

jun.instruct: A young woman of nineteen with a bright, quick soprano and a light Australian accent. Talks fast with nervous energy, clever and funny, drops into a whisper when excited.
jun.ref: Okay, okay, don't panic, I'm totally in. Well, mostly in. Three firewalls down, one to go. Can you maybe punch that guard slightly more quietly?
jun.name: Heirframe · Jun Okafor

halloran.instruct: A woman in her mid-forties with a crisp, cool contralto and a neutral American accent. Clipped military cadence, precise and controlled, almost no emotion.
halloran.ref: This is Warden-Captain Halloran. You are in violation of civic order. Lower your weapons, disconnect your Link, and kneel. I will not ask twice.
halloran.name: Heirframe · Halloran

rook.instruct: A man in his mid-thirties with a relaxed, smoky baritone and a gentle Jamaican English lilt. Unhurried and amused, philosophical, speaks like he has all the time in the world.
rook.ref: Relax, friend. Everybody comes to Rook eventually. Parts, rumours, a little truth if you can afford it. And truth, you know, is the expensive stuff.
rook.name: Heirframe · Rook

elena.instruct: A woman in her fifties with a commanding but warm voice and a neutral American accent. Steady and authoritative, like a starship captain recording a log entry, tired but hopeful.
elena.ref: Captain's log, day one of the journey. Forty thousand souls asleep, and the rest of us awake and terrified. We will make it. We have to make it.
elena.name: Heirframe · Captain Elena Vael

helm.instruct: An androgynous synthetic voice in the mid range, perfectly even and calm, no accent, slow and precise with no emotion.
helm.ref: Renewal protocol active. State your lineage. The ship has waited. The ship will continue to wait. The ship does not forget.
helm.name: Heirframe · The Helm

sal.instruct: A man in his forties with a smooth, fast, cheerful tenor and a New York accent, a friendly used-car salesman.
sal.ref: Hey, hey, hey! Look at you, a rider with taste! Come on in. Every frame on this lot is certified, pre-owned, and practically brand new.
sal.name: Heirframe · Sal Venn

ottoline.instruct: A woman in her sixties with a brisk, raspy voice and a Northern English Yorkshire accent. Blunt, practical and impatient, secretly fond.
ottoline.ref: Right. Put it on the bench. No, not like that. Honestly, what have you done to this poor thing? It's a precision machine, not a tin of beans.
ottoline.name: Heirframe · Ottoline Gearwright

civ_f1.instruct: A woman in her thirties, light and pleasant, polished upper-class British accent, airy and carefree.
civ_f1.ref: Oh, isn't it simply glorious today? We're taking the sky lane up to the Terraces for lunch. Darling, you really must come along.
civ_f1.name: Heirframe · Civilian F1 (affluent)

civ_m1.instruct: A man in his forties, relaxed and friendly, clean neutral American accent, pleasant mid-range.
civ_m1.ref: Hey there, nice morning, isn't it? I just love this time of year. Well, every time of year, really. It's always perfect here.
civ_m1.name: Heirframe · Civilian M1 (affluent)

civ_f2.instruct: A tired woman in her twenties, flat and weary, working-class London accent, low energy.
civ_f2.ref: Another double shift. Link in, link out, sleep in a pod, do it all again. Don't look at me like that. It's just how it is down here.
civ_f2.name: Heirframe · Civilian F2 (Stacks)

civ_m2.instruct: A man in his fifties, gravelly and resigned, Irish accent, mutters.
civ_m2.ref: Forty years I've worked these docks. Forty years, and they still don't know my name. Doesn't matter. Nothing does, down here.
civ_m2.name: Heirframe · Civilian M2 (Stacks)

warden_m.instruct: A man in his thirties, firm and authoritative, neutral accent, police-radio cadence.
warden_m.ref: Unit seven to dispatch. Suspect is a rental frame, orange markings, heading north on Brightline. Requesting a cordon. Over.
warden_m.name: Heirframe · Warden M

warden_f.instruct: A woman in her thirties, firm, clipped, neutral American accent, dispatch cadence.
warden_f.ref: Dispatch to all units. Civic alert in Aurum Plaza. Suspect is armed and unregistered. Use of force is authorised. Out.
warden_f.name: Heirframe · Warden F

thug_m.instruct: A man in his twenties, cocky and aggressive, rough South London accent, shouty.
thug_m.ref: Oi! You! Yeah, you, in the tin can! This is Silverhand turf, mate. You want to walk through here, you pay the toll. Understand?
thug_m.name: Heirframe · Syndicate Thug M

thug_f.instruct: A woman in her thirties, sharp and sneering, New Jersey accent, loud.
thug_f.ref: Well, look what crawled out of the rental lot. You lost, sweetie? 'Cause you're about to be real lost. Get 'em, boys!
thug_f.name: Heirframe · Syndicate Thug F

unlinked.instruct: A young man in his twenties, intense whisper-shout, Scottish Glaswegian accent, urgent.
unlinked.ref: Keep your head down and keep moving! They're scanning the whole block. If they catch you with that key, we're all finished. Go!
unlinked.name: Heirframe · Unlinked Rebel
